facts.fact: CIPESA states Kenya adopted its own national AI strategy in May 2025, with implementation of the National AI Strategy (2025-2030) costed at KSh 152 billion over five years.

CIPESA states a review of Kenya's 2026/27 national budget shows no dedicated funding allocation for the National AI Strategy, the KSh 8.6 billion for the ICT sector going mainly to broadband, digital skills and government digitisation.
